title: Dimensions and span
description: Public fact: 8,980 ft total length, 4,200 ft main span, 746 ft towers — the 1937–1964 world record span.

title: Construction history
description: Public fact: built January 1933–April 1937 under chief engineer Joseph B. Strauss; 11 workers died; the safety net saved 19.

title: International Orange
description: Public fact: the bridge's color — chosen by architect Irving Morrow — and its continuous repainting.

title: Main cables
description: Public fact: two main cables, each 7,650 ft, 27,572 wires per cable — 80,000 miles of wire spun in place.

title: Toll history
description: Public fact: 50¢ at opening; one-way tolling since 1968; all-electronic tolling since March 2013.

title: Suicide deterrent net
description: Public fact: the stainless-steel net completed January 2024 — 20 ft below deck, extending 20 ft out.

title: Seismic retrofit
description: Public fact: the multi-phase seismic retrofit after Loma Prieta (1989) — strengthening the 1937 structure.

title: Fog, wind, and daily operation
description: Public fact: the bridge in its element — fog horns, wind tolerance, and 100,000+ vehicles a day.
